claim: for fixed nonzero directional bias m and finite-correlation geometric sign process, cumulative directional mean overtakes fluctuation scale at H_x approximately ((1-m^2)/m^2)*((1+phi)/(1-phi))
interpretation: small directional bias is hidden for O(1/m^2) generations; positive temporal coherence inflates the short-run fluctuation scale and delays emergence of a weak persistent trend
novelty_boundary: The signal-to-noise algebra is standard asymptotic probability. The repository-specific contribution is linking m and phi to community-state occupancy and persistence downstream of exact C_A/C_F structural selection states.
